verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Viam serves a working llms.txt at docs.viam.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a concise agent-friendly summary, and Viam also publishes dedicated agent-oriented docs describing how an AI agent can drive a machine via CLI/SDK. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of an agent successfully using llms.txt in practice, and no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (all candidates 404) to complement it.
